title: Properties alone on a line cannot belong to a key of the mapping that is already open
notes: Properties of an implicit key stand on the key's own line, in front of the key text (production 193: the key and its `:` share a line). `!!map` alone on line 2 would have to be the properties of a new block mapping, which cannot start at the indentation of the mapping that is open. The line break after `!!map`, line 2 column 6, is the first character that cannot belong. Compare yaml-test-suite H7J7.

provenance.reference: A reader that merged the properties of two lines into the next key, dropped the first line's `!!map`, and read the input as a mapping with two keys.
